title: Tier 3: a microVM with no network device
design_ref: Choosing the isolation boundary (Tier 3); Files, state and results
purpose: Run an analysis on an uploaded file in a sandbox that has no network at all, and get the result back through the router.

steps.display: kubectl -n sandboxes get pod compute-only-pool-plgv5 -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations}'

orch put-text sess-cd4cdd81 uploads/sales.csv 'region,sales
north,120
south,95
north,80
west,60
'
orch exec sess-cd4cdd81 "python3 -c <sum sales by region from /workspace/uploads/sales.csv>"

checks.description: the analysis ran and produced the totals
checks.because: The router reached the sandbox through the Kubernetes exec channel, which does not need a network.

checks.description: the result file came back through the router
checks.because: File transfer uses the same channel.

checks.description: the sandbox has no network device and no route out
checks.because: The annotation boots the microVM without a network interface, so there is nothing to filter and nothing to misconfigure.
